english.title: Include / procure inclusion of electronic cigarette advertisement in UK information society service
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of a business,

(A)_[included]_
(B)_[procured the inclusion of]_

an electronic cigarette advertisement in an information society service, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION SOCIETY SERVICE..), provided to a recipient in the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 43(1), 48(e) and 51 of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
in the course of a business
included / procured the inclusion of
an electronic cigarette advertisement
in information society service
provided to recipient in UK

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence does not apply -
(a) to an information society service which is intended exclusively for professionals in the trade of electronic cigarettes or refill containers; or
(b) to an electronic cigarette advertisement which is not principally intended for the Union market.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
